cloud.title: Bambu Cloud login
cloud.description: Sign in with your Bambu account. No printer IP or LAN access code is required. The login uses ha-bambulab's authentication; MQTT uses Open Bamboo.

verify.title: Verification code
verify.description: Enter the code from {code_source}. 'Send new email/SMS code' switches from authenticator verification to email/SMS verification.

printers.title: Printers
printers.description: Select printers from this account. Existing ha-bambulab entries are updated in place. Signing credentials are optional here; firmware that requires signed commands still needs them.

data.credentials_directory: Slicer signing credentials folder (inside the HA configuration folder)

existing.title: Use existing printer connections
existing.description: Keep the current LAN/cloud settings of your ha-bambulab printers and activate only the Open Bamboo MQTT transport.

data.credentials_directory: Slicer signing credentials folder (inside the HA configuration folder)

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your account credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Bambu Cloud. Try again.
error.cloud_blocked: Bambu Cloud blocked this login or the upstream login dependency is unavailable.
error.code_expired: The code expired. A new email/SMS code was requested.
error.code_incorrect: The code is incorrect. Try again.
error.runtime_unavailable: Native runtime unavailable. Install a built release for Linux amd64/aarch64.
error.outside_config: Choose a folder inside the Home Assistant configuration folder.
error.select_printer: Select at least one printer from this account.

abort.already_configured: Open Bamboo transport is already configured.
abort.no_printers: This account has no supported bound printers.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve printers from Bambu Cloud.
